encoding_notes: Live submission-guidelines page bot-blocked (cookie gate -> idp.springer.com, error=cookies_not_supported); web.archive.org blocked at tool level. Primary values from the directly-read Springer 'Additional Information for Authors' PDF (media.springer.com/.../40279_Sports Medicine.pdf).

Article types from the journal scope corroborated by two WebSearches + manusights 2026 guide: Review Articles, Systematic Reviews, Meta-Analyses, Current Opinions, Letters to the Editor, and selected Original Research Articles. Meta-Analysis folded into systematic_review.
Current Opinion omitted from article_types — no clean schema slot (peer-reviewed opinion/perspective piece; not a standard review or editorial).

Word limits NOT primary-verified and set null: WebSearch of the gated page indicated Review ~8000, Systematic Review ~10,000, Current Opinion ~3000 words, treated as guides only and excluding abstract/references/figure legends/table captions. Verify against the live guide before enforcing.

Abstract structure is type-dependent: narrative reviews unstructured (no headings); original research structured (CONSORT/PRISMA/STROBE); systematic reviews PRISMA. Encoded structured=false for the flagship Review type.

Text must be double-spaced with page numbering (starting with the title page) and line numbering; line-number type (continuous vs per-page) not specified — encoded 'continuous' as the Springer default.
Section headings numbered by the decimal system (1; 2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.2.1; ...), starting with the Introduction and finishing with the Conclusions.

Running heading up to 100 characters. Keywords not required. Key Points (two to three bullets beneath the abstract) required — mapped to highlights_required=true. Plain Language Summary optional, up to 250 words (no schema slot).

Reference style is Springer Basic (numeric, square brackets): 'Reference citations in the text should be identified by numbers in square brackets' and 'numbered consecutively' — mapped to vancouver, in_text=bracket, order=cited. DOI required for preprint references (include_doi left false as not stated for all refs).

Figure formats (EPS for vector graphics, TIFF for halftones) from WebSearch of the gated page (standard Springer template); separate_files inferred from Editorial Manager per-figure upload + format/DPI specs.

Declarations subsection order from the PDF: Funding, Conflicts of Interest, Availability of data and material, Ethics approval, Consent to participate, Consent for publication, Code availability, Author contributions, then Acknowledgements. Funding/Conflicts/Data-availability/Author-contributions are 'required for all manuscripts'; ethics/consent are conditional.
Trial registration number required at the end of the abstract and in the Methods section (PROSPERO for systematic reviews) — placed in abstract/methods, not a Declarations subsection.

orcid_required set false (not stated in primary PDF; manusights secondary guide lists ORCID iDs in the byline). cover_letter_required set true from the manusights guide + standard Editorial Manager practice.
[schema-required default] references.journal_abbrev defaulted to 'nlm' (guide silent; NLM/Index Medicus abbreviations assumed).
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
[schema-required default] layout.headings level styling (case/bold/italic) defaulted where the guide stated only numbering; 'as_is'/false used for unspecified attributes.

2026-07-25 Janine primary-source verification (link.springer.com/journal/40279/submission-guidelines): the previously-null word limits are now guide-verified and encoded, discharging this file's own note "Verify against the live guide before enforcing." Guide states: Review Article "Word count up to 8000"; Systematic Review "Word count up to 10,000"; Letter to the Editor "Word count up to 1000"; Original Research Article states NO word limit -> manuscript_max_words left null. Also encoded: "Current Opinion approximately up to 3000" and "Leading Article up to 4000" have no schema enum slot and are OMITTED. Abstract cap 250 from "150 to 250 words"; the guide adds that systematic reviews and original research may extend "to up to 450 words", so 250 is the stated norm and a 250-450 abstract is a soft, not hard, overage. Figures/tables/references deliberately left null: the guide states "There is no limit on the number of tables, figures or references". The guide's own caveat "The word counts given below are to be treated as guides only" applies to all of the above.
